Strategic Notes

Complementary: 360 fills eastern OK (Sequoyah, Cherokee, Adair, Le Flore) and western OK where E8 has no presence. 62 sites beyond 50km of any E8 tower.

Co-coverage: NE Texas (Fannin/Grayson) and south-central OK (I-35 corridor) show heaviest overlap. 28 sites within 10km of an E8 tower.

Equipment: Both networks run Tarana, enabling shared procurement, NOC, and backhaul coordination.

BEAD: OK BEAD awards: AtLink 6 NETs / $3.5M, 360 listed as provider. Overlap implications for challenge process TBD.
